alt.en: A large row of gray blocks with an indigo newest block sits at the center of a gray floor. A dotted dark line joins a page on the left to the first block, a dashed orange line with packets runs from the newest block to a server rack on the right, and a small teal cube links to the page.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是一排大方块，最新一块为靛蓝色。左侧一页文件以深色点线连到第一块，最新一块以带数据包的橙色虚线连到右侧服务器机柜，一个小青色立方体连到文件。

caption.en: Illustration: a contract document bound to an occurrence ledger of committed calls, which a durable execution engine replays after a model-written revision. It does not depict the authors' system or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：契约文件约束记录已提交调用的出现次数账本，模型修改工作流后，持久化执行引擎据此重放。图中并非作者的系统或经过测试的部署，也不表示这些检查能按所述方式生效。
